main_text.p: רוה Inebriari, ubertim expleri, Irrigare je.
Pihel רוה irrigavit, Inebriavit vel Inebriatus fuit. Hiphil הרוה idem.
רויה f. Irrigua, Irriguum, Inebrians, Exu-berans.
רי m. Irrigatio, juxta quosdam, Job 37.11: at Ab. Efra scribit eam interpretationem longè petitam esse. Vide ברה.
רוח Respiravit, Respiratio fuit. Pyhal Partic. מרוחים Perspirata, Spaciosa, spiritum transmittentia.
רוח c. Spiritus, Ventus, Flatus. Spiritus pro animo, & Ventus pro plaga mundi, unde ventus spirat, sæpè fumitur: plural. רוחות,
Chald. רוחא רוח idem: plural. רוחין, constr. רוח שמיא Venti calorum, Dan.7.2.

רום Altum Elatum, Excelsum esse, Efferre se, Efferri, Elevari, Exaltari. Pihel רומם, Exaltare, Efferre, Extollere. Pyhal רוממ Exaltari. Hiphil הרים Exaltavit, Extu-lit, Obtulit, Suftulit: Abftulit, Separavit.

page.notes: Hebrew forms are copied as far as legible; the vocalisation and some Hebrew letters of the small scan are uncertain and were not verified. The top-left mark is not transcribed.
